newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's NUM rejects planned gold mine job cuts.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's NUM rejects planned gold mine job cuts.

text.p: South Africa's National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) said on Friday it rejected the proposed axing of 4,000 jobs at JCI Ltd's Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Ltd and 3,000 at Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd.
"It is the result of poor planning and short-sightedness on the part of management," it said in a statement.

The union said it had decided to stop Strategic Labour Accord discussions forthwith and withdraw from retrenchment negotiations until a detailed study was completed into the underlying problems at the two mines.
The NUM also called on the JCI board to terminate the services of chief executive John Browning.

JCI announced on Wednesday that it planned to shed between 3,400 and 4,100 Randfontein jobs and cut tonnage throughput as part of a far-reaching restructuring programme. Retrenchments would take place on May 31.
